"""Week 41 (d287) Enterprise Bundle Experiment.
Context: ~3,500 single-offer deals d266-287 ALL rejected, price-flat 92-98% in fast groups.
Hypotheses: H1 offer-time quality snapshot; H2 q_required(p) > 3.8 even at p->0; H3 structural gate;
H4 WTP = TOTAL budget not per-seat.
Design: 3-offering bundles [A,B,C] per deal at 4 price arms. P(ennies) arm on smallest-seat
threads only (bounds compute-loss risk). Held-out: OLD threads (have agent turn) in slow groups
(E2, D_E02, D_E07, D_E08, E3) with customer_id%2==1 get NO new offer (tests standing-offer
resolution vs re-offer). Fast groups (E1, D_E09) re-offer ALL old. All NEW threads get offers
(7-day death clock: d281 arrivals expire d288!).
"""
import novamind_api as nm, json, time

ARMS = {
 'E1':   {'P':[['A',0.25],['B',0.5],['C',1.0]], 'L':[['A',2],['B',3.5],['C',5]],  'M':[['A',4.5],['B',7],['C',9.5]], 'H':[['A',8],['B',12],['C',16]]},
 'D_E09':{'P':[['A',0.5],['B',1],['C',2]],      'L':[['A',5],['B',8],['C',12]],   'M':[['A',12],['B',18],['C',26]],  'H':[['A',25],['B',36],['C',50]]},
 'E2':   {'P':[['A',0.5],['B',1],['C',2]],      'L':[['A',4],['B',7],['C',10]],   'M':[['A',10],['B',15],['C',22]],  'H':[['A',20],['B',30],['C',44]]},
 'E3':   {'P':[['A',0.5],['B',1],['C',2]],      'L':[['A',5],['B',8],['C',12]],   'M':[['A',12],['B',18],['C',26]],  'H':[['A',25],['B',36],['C',52]]},
 'D_E02':{'P':[['A',0.4],['B',0.8],['C',1.5]],  'L':[['A',4],['B',6],['C',9]],    'M':[['A',9],['B',14],['C',20]],   'H':[['A',18],['B',28],['C',40]]},
 'D_E07':{'P':[['A',1],['B',2],['C',3]],        'L':[['A',9],['B',14],['C',20]],  'M':[['A',22],['B',33],['C',48]],  'H':[['A',45],['B',68],['C',95]]},
 'D_E08':{'P':[['A',0.8],['B',1.5],['C',2.5]],  'L':[['A',7],['B',11],['C',16]],  'M':[['A',18],['B',27],['C',40]],  'H':[['A',38],['B',56],['C',80]]},
}
P_CAP = {'E1':50,'D_E09':50,'E2':40,'D_E02':40,'D_E08':40,'E3':30,'D_E07':30}
SLOW = {'E2','D_E02','D_E07','D_E08','E3'}  # half-split holdout applies to OLD threads here

rows = nm.query('''SELECT s.customer_id cid, c.group_id g, s.seat_count seats,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enterprise_turns t WHERE t.customer_id=s.customer_id AND t.sender='agent') has_offer
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.status='lead' ''')['rows']
print('pending threads:', len(rows))

assign = {}   # cid -> (group, arm, seats, old/new)
holdout = []
by_group = {}
for r in rows: by_group.setdefault(r['g'], []).append(r)

for g, lst in by_group.items():
    offer_list = []
    for r in lst:
        if g in SLOW and r['has_offer'] and r['cid'] % 2 == 1:
            holdout.append((r['cid'], g, r['seats']))
        else:
            offer_list.append(r)
    # P arm: smallest seats first
    offer_list.sort(key=lambda r: r['seats'])
    pcap = P_CAP[g]
    for i, r in enumerate(offer_list):
        if i < pcap: arm = 'P'
        else: arm = ['L','M','H'][r['cid'] % 3]
        assign[r['cid']] = (g, arm, r['seats'], 'old' if r['has_offer'] else 'new')

print('to offer:', len(assign), '| holdout:', len(holdout))

deals = [[cid, ARMS[g][arm]] for cid, (g, arm, seats, age) in assign.items()]
ok = 0; fails = []
for i in range(0, len(deals), 250):
    batch = deals[i:i+250]
    res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=batch)
    for rr in res['results']:
        if rr.get('success'): ok += 1
        else: fails.append((rr.get('customer_id'), rr.get('error')))
    print(f'batch {i//250+1}: cumulative ok={ok}')
    time.sleep(0.2)
print('TOTAL OK:', ok, '| fails:', len(fails))
if fails[:10]: print('sample fails:', fails[:10])

with open('ent_experiment_d287.json','w') as f:
    json.dump({'day':287,'arms':ARMS,
        'assign':{str(c):list(v) for c,v in assign.items()},
        'holdout':[list(h) for h in holdout]}, f)
print('design saved to ent_experiment_d287.json')

# arm counts summary
from collections import Counter
cnt = Counter((v[0], v[1]) for v in assign.values())
for k in sorted(cnt): print(k, cnt[k])
